text:
Aapka order (ORD-22009) is waqt "in transit" hai aur Delhivery ke paas hai. Chunki order dispatch ho chuka hai, system ke through delivery address change karna sambhav nahi hai. 

Main aapko ek human agent (senior support) ke paas transfer kar raha hoon, jo aapki is problem ka koi behtar hal nikal sakein. Kripya thoda intezaar karein.
